achievements.label: First Ore
achievements.description: Mine Iron on Earth for the first time.

achievements.label: Automated
achievements.description: Build Earth's first Auto-Miner — mining without clicking.

achievements.label: Recycler Online
achievements.description: Build your first Recycler, on any world.

achievements.label: Off-World
achievements.description: Travel beyond Earth for the first time.

achievements.label: Trade Route Established
achievements.description: Open your first trade route between two worlds.

achievements.label: Near Bodies Charted
achievements.description: Fund the Near Bodies research tier to completion.

achievements.label: Solar System Unlocked
achievements.description: Unlock travel access to every body in the solar system.

achievements.label: Far Bodies Charted
achievements.description: Fund every research tier to completion.

achievements.label: Grand Tour
achievements.description: Physically visit every world in the solar system, not just unlock them.

achievements.label: Governor Appointed
achievements.description: Let the Governor manage a world while you were away.

achievements.label: Sky City Founder
achievements.description: Build a Sky City above one of the gas giants' moons.

achievements.label: Trade Network
achievements.description: Maintain 5 or more trade routes across the solar system at once.

achievements.label: Ecological Balance
achievements.description: Run a full mining economy on a world while keeping its ecological health at 95% or higher.

achievements.label: Resource Baron
achievements.description: Bank one million of a single resource on one world at once.

achievements.label: Terraformer
achievements.description: Fully terraform your first world.

achievements.label: Eight Economies
achievements.description: Run an active Auto-Miner economy on every world at the same time.

achievements.label: Planetary Renaissance
achievements.description: Fully terraform four worlds at once.

achievements.label: New Solar System
achievements.description: Terraform every world to 100% — the same milestone that triggers the game's win banner.

achievements.label: Quick Start
achievements.description: Fund the Near Bodies research tier to completion within 10 minutes of play.

achievements.label: Swift Expansion
achievements.description: Fund every research tier to completion within 30 minutes of play.

achievements.label: Manual Labor
achievements.description: Bank 100 Iron on Earth by clicking alone, before ever building a generator anywhere.

achievements.label: Off the Grid
achievements.description: Fund the Near Bodies research tier to completion without ever building a generator anywhere.

achievements.label: Close Call
achievements.description: Let a world's ecology fall below 3%, then bring it back above 50%.

achievements.label: Back From the Brink
achievements.description: Let a world collapse to 0% ecology, then restore it above 50%.

achievements.label: In Rhythm
achievements.description: Keep a mining rhythm going for 40 clicks in a row, each within a second and a half of the last.

achievements.label: Chain Reactor
achievements.description: Find every chain reaction: the short action sequences listed on the Chain Reactions page.

achievements.label: Codex Keeper
achievements.description: Find all seven hidden Codex entries: the odd sentences at the end of the world notes in the Overview.

achievements.label: Weather Watcher
achievements.description: Live through all six System Anomalies: Comet Pass, Solar Flare, Meteor Shower, Magnetic Storm, Clear Skies and Dust Cloud.

achievements.label: Charter Member
achievements.description: Earn 5 Charter stamps by finishing missions on the Mission Board.

achievements.label: The Great Works
achievements.description: Build all four Megaprojects in a single run: Orbital Mirror, Ring Habitat, Dyson Sail and Deep Core Tap.
